answer: Admission is a one-shot survey, not a copied key. The applicant locks 55 coins and must stand at a unique vertex of a surveyed harbor grid at the next published low tide. There it photographs a seed-chosen ivory benchmark whose serial already sits on-ledger. Two watchers who have never co-sealed confirm the photo hashes and GPS stamps within 90 minutes. The bond unlocks after 11 days only if the hash matches and no other identity reused the mark. A reused benchmark or the same watcher pair burns both stakes, so a clone farm pays for a fresh grid slot and a new ivory mark on every fake name.
